Package SnakeGame

package SnakeGame
This package contains the main classes and logic for the SnakeGame application. It includes the game models, controllers, and other related components.

The SnakeGame package is organized into subpackages for better code organization and readability. Each subpackage has its specific purpose, such as models, controllers, and views.

For more information, see the individual classes and packages within this package.
